name: Yoake Eimu
source:
A mysterious girl who protects the main character. She is usually quiet and reserved, but when it comes to combat she fights her enemies with agile movements that are a stark difference from her usual self.

Unlike other ayakashi users, she can control two ayakashi.

[From [url=http://www.t-apricot.jp/products/aya/chara.html]ApRicoT[/url]]
